summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026). I rapidly build and validate AI prototypes leveraging large language models and emerging generative technologies to solve operational challenges. Experienced in deploying inference systems on resource-constrained edge devices, optimizing under latency and cost budgets, and defining technical requirements for handoff to scaling teams.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Built a voice-controlled robotic system integrating three AI pipeline components: voice intent classification (Gemini LLM), visual servoing (TensorRT-optimized YOLO), and contact-aware grasping via ToF sensors—all coordinated through a unified WebSocket architecture spanning mobile client, Flask edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller.

Achieved 5.2× inference speedup (56.7→10.9ms) via TensorRT quantization; debugged and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, frame capture issues) to achieve 100% pick reliability at 11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Architected a LeRobot-compatible multi-camera data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for structured frame capture and action labeling, enabling seamless handoff to downstream training teams.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (Vision Transformer) for medical billing document understanding; engineered domain-specific preprocessing, special token integration, and embedding layer resizing to match custom vocabulary.
Improved validation accuracy 55%→93% through iterative model tuning and preprocessing refinement, delivering a functional prototype under tight 3-month timeline.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Led a 7-person cross-cultural team as the sole ML expert; restructured task distribution mid-project and delivered a multi-modal MRI segmentation pipeline using U-Net with VGG/ResNet backbones, reporting accuracy-latency tradeoffs for deployment.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced LLM memory footprint by 55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml.
Benchmarked quantized model on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy degradation—validating near-lossless compression for resource-constrained edge deployment.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, residual connections, layer normalization; trained on custom text corpus with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.
Demonstrates foundational understanding of generative model architecture and transformer fundamentals.
